subject: OpenLib: demo request & GitHub integration
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@openlib.org>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenLib Team <team@openlib.org>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — OpenLib / GitHub integration

Hi Alex,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday while evaluating inference options for OpenLib (we're an open-source organization that serves libraries with search and summarization features). A few folks on our team want a quick demo to understand how Redwood would fit into our CI/CD and GitHub-based workflows.

Specific questions we want to cover:
- Do you support integration with GitHub repositories and GitHub Actions for model sync and deployment?
- How does credentials/access work for open-source repos and monorepos?
- Any recommended approach for running inference against large codebases?

We're in US/PST. Availability this week: Tue 7/7 10–12 PDT or Wed 7/8 14–16 PDT. If those don't work, happy to share a few other windows.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Klein
Platform Lead, OpenLib
jordan.klein@openlib.org

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@openlib.org>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — OpenLib / GitHub integration

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a short demo and walk through GitHub integration patterns. Short answers up front: Redwood can integrate with GitHub repos (webhooks, private repo access via deploy keys or token-based sync), and we have recommended patterns for monorepos and Actions-based deployments. I can have one of our solutions engineers join to go deeper on architecture.

Would any of these slots work for a 30-min demo?
- Tue 7/7 — 10:30 AM PDT
- Tue 7/7 — 11:30 AM PDT
- Wed 7/8 — 2:30 PM PDT

If you'd prefer, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-alex/30min-demo

I attached a short one-pager on using Redwood with open-source projects (redwood_open_source_brief.pdf) and a link to our GitHub integration docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/integrations/github

If you can confirm attendees (we typically invite a product/PM and an engineer), I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_open_source_brief.pdf (1 page PDF summary)

From: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@openlib.org>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenLib Team <team@openlib.org>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — OpenLib / GitHub integration

Thanks Alex — Tue 7/7 10:30 AM PDT works for us. I'll invite our lead engineer (Priya) and our product manager. A couple of notes so the demo can be productive:
- We'd like to show a small repo or example so your SE can talk through deployment options — is it OK to share a private repo invite ahead of time?
- We're extra-sensitive about credentials; can your SE cover how Redwood handles repo access tokens and least-privilege patterns?

If anything changes I'll update, otherwise see you at 10:30.

Jordan

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@openlib.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: OpenLib demo — adding SE + agenda

Forwarding to loop in our SE — Marissa Cole — who will join to cover security and GitHub integration patterns. Marissa, Jordan from OpenLib signed up and confirmed Tue 7/7 10:30 AM PDT. Attendees: Jordan (platform lead), Priya (engineer), OpenLib PM.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 5m quick intros + goals
- 10m demo (model serving + GitHub integration walkthrough)
- 10m security/credentials and deployment patterns
- 5m next steps (trial plan, follow-up technical deep-dive)

Marissa — can you confirm you'll join? Also, if you prefer a different time, we may need to reschedule — I have a conflict at 11:00 that could push if we start late.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@openlib.org>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OpenLib demo — agenda + pre-demo checklist

Hi Jordan — thanks for the invite, I'll be on the call Tue 7/7 10:30 AM PDT. A couple quick asks to make the session useful:
- If you can grant a short-lived read-only invite to the example repo (or send a link to a small sample), we'll use it during the demo. Deploy keys or a scoped token are fine.
- Please complete the 2-field pre-demo checklist: repo link and primary use-case (e.g., "search over docs", "code summarization"). You can paste those into this thread.

I'm attaching a simple demo agenda that we'll follow (demo-agenda.pdf). For security, we'll cover least-privilege patterns and our recommended token rotation cadence.

See you Wednesday (copying Alex because of the calendar conflict — Alex, if we need to move the call later, please propose two alternate times and I'll coordinate).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (2 page PDF)
